calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: Violet Fairweather, please. Her library books are overdue again.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Dorothy Quinn, please. Just a small question about a small loan.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: The shopkeeper, please. I've run out of ink in the middle of a murder.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Police, love! My Garfield's gone missing again!

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: Miss Ellis, please. My class needs twenty copies of Hamlet.

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: Dr Sharma, please. I sneezed twice. Is that bad?

calls.name: Dr Ravi Sharma
calls.message: Mrs Higgins, please. She's late for her check-up. Again.

calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: The teacher, please. His pupils have drawn moustaches in every book I own.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: High Street 4, please. I need fish. Not for me. For when he comes home.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Hospital! I've dropped a crate of tins on my foot!

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: My husband, please. He's forgotten his lunch again.

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: Connect me with my wife. Is my lunch at the bank?

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: PC Plodwell! Any news on my cat? He's ginger. And very handsome.

calls.name: PC Percy Plodwell
calls.message: The detective, please. It's Mrs Higgins' cat again.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: The shop. Do you sell cough syrup? The strong kind. Purely professional.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Voyager Road 11, please. My new novel needs a real detective. Or a cheap one.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: The writer. I have an idea for your next book.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: The constable, please. Someone keeps nicking sardines from my shop.

calls.name: Dr Ravi Sharma
calls.message: High Street 6, please. Have you anything on rare diseases? Asking for a patient.

calls.name: PC Percy Plodwell
calls.message: The lady at Voyager Road 10, please. My wages are late again.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Fire brigade! My kitchen's on fire! I was too busy writing!

calls.name: Garfield Higgins
calls.message: Meow.

calls.name: Mr Gnome
calls.message: Mrs Higgins, please. Your cat is sleeping in my flowerbed. Again.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Put me through to my cat. I know he's got a phone. I pay the bill.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: The constable, please. A gnome keeps staring through my shop window.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: The doctor. I need something for my head. It's a work injury.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Miss Ellis, please. I've finished my novel! Save me a shelf.

calls.name: Mr Gnome
calls.message: High Street 4, please. I need seeds. And a hat. A smaller hat.

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: My wife, please. I've locked myself out. Again.

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: The shop, please. We're out of tea. This is very serious.

calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: The gardener, please. The roses outside the library look very sad.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Fire brigade! Garfield's stuck up the chimney!

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: Hospital, quick! I tripped over a clue.
